structuredContent.body:
## Purpose
Fix the T18 demonstrated TOCTOU window: a worker may retain authorization after another worker becomes owner and append twice. Candidate only; **DO NOT MERGE / DO NOT PROMOTE** without independent regression and real sink evidence.

## Scope
- Fails closed with `SINK_ATOMIC_WRITE_REQUIRED` for unsupported non-idempotent writes.
- Explicitly limits Sheets writes to one atomic batch creating a unique sheet and writing only that new sheet.
- Requires deterministic path/version parameters for GitHub create/update.
- Trusted host write adapters may opt in to sink atomic semantics; they must be separately reviewed.
- Adds T18/T19 positive/negative tests plus documentation. No stable V2 path changes.

## Evidence
- Baseline: two independent old-engine unsafe appends caused two provider effects in controlled V8 fixture; historical T18 live test showed 2 matching rows.
- Candidate V8 execution: 17/17 test callbacks passed; native Node 22 GitHub CI must be independently checked.
- Real isolated Google Sheets sink-atomic patterns previously passed T19/T20; the new candidate code still needs fresh real connector verification.

## Boundaries
No general exactly-once, fencing, lease takeover, or unrestricted arbitrary writes claim. Review potential backward compatibility impact: unguarded historical writes now intentionally BLOCKED. Do not merge main.

structuredContent.body:
## Released in PR #119

Work Skill Router V2.0.0 was released through [PR #119](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/pull/119) at [`6777dc4`](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/commit/6777dc481487bc72cac219d4b58658009453bac1). The release branch used main as its base. This draft retains the original candidate evidence.

## Work V2 stability evidence

The candidate meets the release-review gate for Work GitHub reads and bounded recovery. Three frozen tasks scored 5/5 across all three routing arms under independent blind review. A one-shot scheduled Work run completed two reads and both raw receipts were checked against pinned Git objects. [Raw evidence and verdict](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/tree/e856e1443058ce65d199bdf4fec5af912fd3c547/skills/loop/router_v2/evidence/stability-2026-11-21).

This commit adds evidence only. The release itself remains pending review and integration of the candidate base (#116). Production MetaLoop operation remains outside this tested scope.

## Current candidate · Work execution verified on 2026-11-21

- `work_host.js` runs inside Work and dispatches allowlisted reads, saves raw results and hands off selected Skills to the active model. The Python bridge manages requests and records. On a failed GitHub file read it allows one path correction within the original repository and revision.
- [Three Work tasks and original evidence](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/tree/af94fbae23326e6ac9626bf525407fcaf59f7659/skills/loop/router_v2/evidence/work-2026-11-21). A reproduces the plan-only bridge and verifies the candidate handoff. B reconciles the N07 source data and produces a release checklist, with a replay that selected the second Skill after the causal output. C records a real 404 followed by a verified read of the corrected path.
- [Independent review and counterexamples](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/tree/af94fbae23326e6ac9626bf525407fcaf59f7659/skills/loop/router_v2/evidence/work-2026-11-21/independent-review.json). The follow-up driver now checks typed connector responses and verifies Skill source bytes against the catalog and pinned Git object. Dedicated JS contract checks and all 58 local Python tests passed.
- [Three-arm raw run archive](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/tree/af94fbae23326e6ac9626bf525407fcaf59f7659/skills/loop/router_v2/evidence/work-2026-11-21/three-arm-raw.zip). One frozen local task, three isolated model contexts, independent blind grading. Single, fixed and dynamic each scored 5/5. The dynamic arm routed directly. This comparison does not establish general superiority.
- Remains Draft / DO_NOT_PROMOTE. The tested entrypoint uses the active Work session. It has no unattended native model launcher, and the historical MetaLoop hourly deployment was not repaired.

<details>
<summary>Earlier candidate history</summary>

## Scope
Implement an opt-in **Skill Router V2 candidate** on top of PR #116. Targets: P0 local execution receipt bridge; P1 discovery from `SKILL.md`; P2 evidence/permission checks. Stable `loop` and `main` untouched.

## Concrete deliveries
- `skills/loop/router_v2/engine.py`: discover, lexical candidate match, direct/chain plan, allowlisted local filesystem execution (read/write/replace/assert), SHA-256 receipts and append-only trace, local recheck.
- `tests.py`: 21 deterministic and real-local test scenarios (not model A/B).
- `demo_write.json` / `demo_replace.json`: two different real sandbox file tasks, without fabricated market or AML evidence.
- `.github/workflows/skill-router-v2-candidate.yml`: run tests, execute two fixture tasks, test blocked unauthorized write, and upload raw artifact/trace/recheck JSON.
- `README.md`: source/permission boundaries, run commands, roll-back, promotion gate.

## Explicit limits
- This **does not execute** arbitrary model Skills; discovered SKILL.md has execution_binding=UNREGISTERED. Required model Skills fail closed as BLOCKED_SKILL_EXECUTOR.
- Human-readable natural language is **not** compiled automatically into TaskSpec. This candidate uses explicit structured JSON and simple lexical retrieval.
- Local sandbox output can reach COMPLETED_UNVERIFIED, not VERIFIED. Independent goal verification and three-arm single/fixed/dynamic model A/B are **NOT_RUN**.
- Passing CI does not establish business outcome or model efficacy. PR remains **Draft / DO_NOT_PROMOTE** pending independent real-task evidence.

## Review points
1. Confirm real file receipts and correct blocked/failed states from CI artifact.
2. Check directory traversal and symlink handling; allowlisted ops only, no shell from TaskSpec.
3. Do not merge before independent execution worker and trusted host authorization/broker implementation.

## 2026-11-21 actual execution receipts (verified from GitHub)
- Latest head: `bb446e8935a46c76edfa0dd5acf362fdc7e7eb4a`.
- [21/21 unit/contract tests + two distinct sandbox file executions + unauthorized-write block: SUCCESS](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/actions/runs/44857855902).
- [Skills regression: SUCCESS](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/actions/runs/44857855931).
- [Raw CI artifact: 16 sandbox trace/report/plan/recheck/output files](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/actions/runs/44857855902/artifacts/14688457106).
- Before final CI, found and fixed a false-positive verification risk: blocked runs could previously pass a local recheck if expected files already existed. Now recheck rejects noncompleted runs, missing/out-of-order receipts, or changed task manifest; two new tests added.
- All live execution evidence here is local file IO under the runner, **not** autonomous execution of domain/model Skills or independent business outcome validation. Real model A/B = NOT_RUN. PR remains Draft / DO_NOT_PROMOTE.


## 2026-11-21 P0 native-host bridge results

- Candidate head: `06c23284dd275cf424eeecce6fd0b6faaee298e6`; still Draft / DO_NOT_PROMOTE.
- New thin native-model entrypoint: `skills/skill-router/SKILL.md`. It instructs the current ChatGPT/Work host to translate the user goal into a HostPlan and call **actually available, authorized host tools**; there is no external model API.
- `skills/loop/router_v2/host_bridge.py` provides allowlisted host capability names, dependency ordering, explicit write-authorization gating, step request digests, and recorded host receipts. **It cannot initiate calls into Work**; the host must perform them. Reported receipts are never authenticated by this script.
- [Latest candidate workflow](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/actions/runs/44861778105): **21 existing + 19 host bridge contract tests PASS**, two real local sandbox file executions PASS, unauthorized write blocked, host protocol correctly stopped at `AWAITING_HOST_EXECUTION` (no mock external tool call misrepresented as live).
- [Repository Skills Regression](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/actions/runs/44861778140): SUCCESS.
- [Raw CI artifacts](https://github.com/lovemoganna/Org-Skills/actions/runs/44861778105/artifacts/14690296321): workflow trace/report/plan/recheck data, including host pre-execution request.
- Final state for host-provided syntactic receipts is `RECEIPTS_RECORDED_UNVERIFIED`, not `COMPLETED` or `VERIFIED`. Host BLOCKED stays BLOCKED.

### Blocking gaps to stable

1. **No callable native Work model/skill executor is exposed to the Python bridge in this environment**. Current model can orchestrate connected tools in chat/Work but this is *host-mediated*, not autonomous Python Skill execution.
2. Real natural-language semantic selection, multi-Skill live outputs and independently checked goal outcomes have not been evaluated as a cohort; earlier Skill Router A/B three-arm study remains **NOT_RUN**.
3. Host receipt syntax checks are not external source authentication. Never promote a host-reported result without inspecting actual underlying tool records and goal-boundary evidence.

No merge to main, no claim of a complete P0 Work runtime integration.


</details>

## 目标 / Decision: ACCEPT
在不覆盖稳定的 Skill Router V2.0.0 前提下，增加军团化跨工具执行候选：自然语言由 Work 宿主编译 Plan、独立工具步并行、Skill 步由原生模型执行并回填、每步回执与验收证据覆盖。

## 实际修改
- `skills/loop/router_v2/legion_host.js`：显式工具注册（GitHub、Google Sheets、Parallel），最多三路独立步骤并行，依赖门禁，写入审批回调，阶段性 checkpoint、错误阻断、原生 Skill 交接。
- `skills/loop/router_v2/tests/test_legion.js`：7 个模拟适配器测试，含并行、跨域、模型步骤、失败、写权限与持久化回调。
- `skills/loop/router_v2/LEGION.md`：调用协议、使用方法、边界和回滚。
- `skills/skill-router/SKILL.md`、`README.md`：新增可选军团模式入口，不改动稳定路径。
- `.github/workflows/legion-contract.yml`：候选与旧版回归 CI。

## 验证
- 本地 Node 22：7/7 mock contract tests 通过；不等于真实 Work E2E。
- CI：已配置，等待 GitHub Actions 独立执行记录。
- 真实 GitHub/Sheets connector 元数据：本次开发时分别完成读取，但**尚未使用 Legion 脚本驱动跨工具 Work E2E**。
- 定时自动运行、自动故障恢复、跨模型自主调用：NOT_IMPLEMENTED / NOT_VERIFIED。

## 兼容性、权限与剩余风险
- 旧 V2 实现不改动。此 PR 不合并、不发布 Stable。
- 主机实际授权、模型 Skill 输出真实性、checkpoint 安全存储由 Work 宿主负责。
- 如需回滚：关闭军团模式，继续调用既有 `skills/loop/router_v2/work_host.js`。

## 下一门槛
运行真实同一 Work 会话中的 GitHub + Google Sheets 双适配器任务，保存原始回执并独立验收，再评估是否扩大可写工具与调度能力。

## 新增实测（2026-11-22 UTC）
- 在当前 Chat 代码宿主中从此分支取回 `legion_host.js`，校验固定 Git Blob SHA `4778905b6c53442f47210a3cd94dc1f850e96eb0` 后执行候选代码。
- 同一任务并行调用两个**真实连接器**：GitHub 仓库元数据、Google Sheets 工作簿元数据；2/2 返回 SUCCESS，状态 `COMPLETED_UNVERIFIED`。
- 通过直接重新读取相同资源，比对两处元数据字段，结果一致；这属于**同宿主自检**，不是独立评审，也不是 Work 原生模型 Skill 链 E2E。
- 回执原文未写入公开仓库；控制台中的证据账本记录了执行结果和边界。当前演示的 checkpoint 为内存回调，不证明断点跨会话恢复。
- 新增经审查的宿主适配器扩展和一次读取重试；本地 Node 9/9 测试通过，GitHub 最新 CI：Legion/Router/全仓均 success。
